description: menus.json guard: backs up Kando's menus.json before Claude edits it, checks it after, and restores the backup if the edit broke the JSON.

hooks.command:
echo \' >/dev/null
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.sh" before
' | Out-Null
try { [Console]::InputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false } catch {}
$kandoEvent = @($input) -join "`n"; $mode = 'before'
Invoke-Expression (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 (Join-Path $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT 'hooks/guard.ps1'))

echo \' >/dev/null
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.sh" after
' | Out-Null
try { [Console]::InputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false } catch {}
$kandoEvent = @($input) -join "`n"; $mode = 'after'
Invoke-Expression (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 (Join-Path $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT 'hooks/guard.ps1'))
